label: API quota
intent: A request spends one permit from the allowance. Light: the middle permit is drawn out to the right, leaving a speed line in its slot, and snaps back into the stack with a hit and a small rebound. Strong: the permit is gripped (a short pull back) and yanked further out, snaps back with a hit and a second smaller knock, and the permits above and below flinch apart as it seats.

streak.//: hidden at rest: a speed line in the slot the permit leaves; it draws back from the permit, drifts after it and fades before the permit returns

motion.//: The permit travels 5 (Strong 6.5) and stays 1.4 inside the canvas at Bold; it snaps back in under half the time it took to go out.
